title: Basic sentences with 是
pattern: A 是 B
explanation: 是 (shì) joins two nouns, like the English word 'is'. It never changes form: I am, you are, he is — all use 是. To say 'is not', put 不 before 是.

examples.py: wǒ shì xué sheng。
tā shì lǎo shī。
zhè bù shì wǒ de shū。

quiz.prompt: How do you say 'She is a doctor'?

quiz.py: wǒ bù shì lǎo shī。

title: Questions with 吗
pattern: Statement + 吗？
explanation: To turn any statement into a yes-or-no question, simply add 吗 (ma) at the end. The word order does not change at all.

examples.py: nǐ shì Zhōng guó rén má？
tā zài jiā má？
nǐ hǎo má？

quiz.py: nǐ shì xué sheng má？

options: At the end of the sentence

title: Adjectives with 很
pattern: Subject + 很 + adjective
explanation: Chinese does not use 是 with adjectives. Instead the subject is linked to the adjective with 很 (hěn). Here 很 is almost neutral; it only means 'very' when you stress it.

examples.py: wǒ hěn hǎo。
jīn tiān hěn lěng。
zhè gè cài hěn hǎo chī。

quiz.py: wǒ mā ma hěn gāo xìng。

title: Possession with 的
pattern: Owner + 的 + thing
explanation: 的 (de) works like the English 's. 我的 means 'my', 你的 means 'your'. With family members and close relationships 的 is often dropped: 我妈妈, 我朋友.

examples.py: zhè shì wǒ de shū。
nà shì lǎo shī de chē。
wǒ mā ma shì yī shēng。

quiz.py: nà shì tā de bēi zi。

title: Measure words with 个
pattern: Number + 个 + noun
explanation: Between a number and a noun, Chinese needs a measure word. 个 (gè) is the general one and works for people and many things. 这个 and 那个 mean 'this one' and 'that one'.

examples.py: wǒ yǒu sān gè péng you。
zhè gè rén shì shéi？
wǒ yào liǎng gè píng guǒ。

quiz.py: wǒ yǒu yī gè gē ge。

quiz.prompt: Which number changes to 两 before 个?

title: Having with 有 and 没有
pattern: Subject + 有 / 没有 + noun
explanation: 有 (yǒu) means 'to have' or 'there is'. Its negative is always 没有 (méi yǒu), never 不有. It also tells what exists in a place: 家里有人 — there is someone at home.

examples.py: wǒ yǒu yī gè dì di。
tā méi yǒu qián。
zhè r yǒu shuǐ má？

quiz.en: Do you have a younger sister?
quiz.py: nǐ yǒu mèi mei má？

title: Question words stay in place
pattern: 什么 / 谁 / 哪儿 / 几 in the answer's position
explanation: In Chinese a question word sits exactly where the answer will go. 你叫什么名字？ — 我叫王明。 You never move the question word to the front.

examples.py: nǐ jiào shén me míng zi？
tā shì shéi？
nǐ qù nǎ r？

quiz.en: What do you want to eat?
quiz.py: nǐ xiǎng chī shén me？

title: Location with 在
pattern: Subject + 在 + place (+ verb)
explanation: 在 (zài) tells where something is: 我在家 — I am at home. Put the place before the action: 我在家吃饭 — I eat at home. The place always comes before the verb, not after it.

examples.py: wǒ zài Běi jīng。
tā zài xué xiào xué xí。
nǐ zài nǎ r gōng zuò？

quiz.py: tā zài shāng diàn。

title: Time words come first
pattern: Subject + time + verb (or time + subject + verb)
explanation: Words like 今天, 明天, 现在, 八点 go before the verb, usually right after the subject or at the very start. 我今天去 — I go today. Never put them at the end like English.

examples.py: wǒ jīn tiān hěn máng。
míng tiān wǒ qù Běi jīng。
tā bā diǎn shàng bān。

quiz.py: wǒ míng tiān qù xué xiào。

title: Wanting and being able: 想, 要, 会, 能
pattern: Subject + 想 / 要 / 会 / 能 + verb
explanation: 想 means 'would like to', 要 is stronger: 'want to, going to'. 会 is a learned ability (I can swim) and 能 is being able in a situation (I can come today). All sit right before the main verb.

examples.en: I would like to drink tea.
examples.py: wǒ xiǎng hē chá。
wǒ huì shuō Hàn yǔ。
tā jīn tiān bù néng lái。

quiz.en: I want to go to China.
quiz.py: wǒ xiǎng qù Zhōng guó。

title: Completed actions with 了
pattern: Verb + 了
explanation: 了 (le) after a verb shows the action is done or that something has changed. 我吃了 — I ate. For 'did not', use 没 and drop 了: 我没吃.

examples.py: wǒ chī le sān gè píng guǒ。
tā qù Běi jīng le。

examples.en: I did not watch the film.
examples.py: wǒ mò kàn diàn yǐng。

quiz.py: tā hē le chá。

title: Doing something now: 在 + verb
pattern: Subject + 在 + verb (+ 呢)
explanation: To say an action is happening right now, put 在 before the verb: 我在吃饭 — I am eating. 呢 at the end makes it softer. 正在 is a slightly stronger version.

examples.py: wǒ zài kàn shū。
tā zài dǎ diàn huà ne。
nǐ zài zuò shén me？

quiz.py: mā ma zài zuò fàn。

quiz.prompt: What does 在 before a verb show?

title: Past experience with 过
pattern: Verb + 过
explanation: 过 (guo) after a verb means you have had the experience at some time: 我去过中国 — I have been to China. The negative is 没 + verb + 过.

examples.py: wǒ qù guò Běi jīng。

examples.en: Have you ever eaten Chinese food?
examples.py: nǐ chī guò Zhōng guó cài má？

examples.en: He has never seen this film.
examples.py: tā mò kàn guò zhè gè diàn yǐng。

quiz.py: nǐ kàn guò xióng māo má？

title: Comparing with 比
pattern: A 比 B + adjective
explanation: 比 (bǐ) compares two things: 我比他高 — I am taller than him. Do not add 很 before the adjective. To say 'much taller', add 多了 after it: 高多了.

examples.py: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān lěng。

examples.en: He is two years older than me.
examples.py: tā bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì。

examples.en: This one is much more expensive than that one.
examples.py: zhè gè bǐ nà gè guì duō le。

quiz.py: Běi jīng bǐ shàng hǎi dà。

title: Doing two things: 一边…一边…
pattern: 一边 + verb 1，一边 + verb 2
explanation: Use 一边…一边… to show two actions at the same time: 他一边吃饭一边看电视 — he watches TV while eating.

examples.en: I listen to music while walking.
examples.py: wǒ yī biān zǒu yī biān tīng yīn yuè。
tā yī biān xiào yī biān shuō。
bié yī biān chī yī biān shuō huà。

quiz.py: tā yī biān zuò fàn yī biān chàng gē。

options: 我一边听音乐一边学习。
我听音乐一边学习一边。

title: Result and ability with 得 and 不
pattern: Verb + 得 / 不 + result (听得懂 / 听不懂)
explanation: Put 得 (de) between a verb and its result to say it is possible, and 不 to say it is not. 听得懂 — can understand (by listening); 听不懂 — cannot understand. 看得见 / 看不见 — can / cannot see.

examples.py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng。
nǐ kàn dé jiàn má？
zhè gè zì wǒ xiě dé chū lái。

quiz.py: nǐ tīng dé dǒng má？

title: Describing how: verb + 得
pattern: Verb + 得 + adjective
explanation: To describe how an action is done, add 得 after the verb and then the adjective: 他跑得很快 — he runs fast. If the verb has an object, repeat the verb: 他说汉语说得很好.

examples.py: tā pǎo dé hěn kuài。
nǐ shuō dé hěn hǎo。
tā chàng gē chàng dé zhēn hǎo tīng。

quiz.py: tā xiě dé hěn piào liang。

title: Going to: 要…了 and 快…了
pattern: 快 / 要 + verb + 了
explanation: 快…了 and 要…了 mean something is about to happen: 快下雨了 — it is about to rain. 快 cannot follow a time word; 要 can: 他明天要走了.

examples.en: It is going to rain soon.
examples.py: kuài xià yǔ le。
wǒ men yào dào le。

examples.en: The train is about to leave.
examples.py: huǒ chē yào kāi le。

quiz.py: kuài shàng kè le。

title: Both…and…: 又…又… / 也
pattern: 又 + adj 1 + 又 + adj 2
explanation: 又…又… links two qualities that are true at the same time: 又便宜又好 — cheap and good. 也 (also) goes before the verb, never at the end.

examples.en: This dish is cheap and tasty.
examples.py: zhè gè cài yòu pián yi yòu hǎo chī。
tā yòu gāo yòu shuài。
wǒ yě xǐ huan。

quiz.en: This room is big and bright.
quiz.py: zhè gè fáng jiān yòu dà yòu liàng。

title: Asking how far / how long: 离 and 多
pattern: A 离 B + 很近 / 很远 ；多 + adjective
explanation: 离 (lí) gives distance between two places: 我家离学校很近 — my home is close to school. 多 + adjective asks 'how…?': 多远 — how far, 多长时间 — how long, 多大 — how old.

examples.en: Is your home far from here?
examples.py: nǐ jiā lí zhè r yuǎn má？
nǐ duō dà le？

examples.zh: 从这儿到机场要多长时间？
examples.en: How long does it take from here to the airport?
examples.py: cóng zhè r dào jī chǎng yào duō zhǎng shí jiān？

quiz.en: How far is it from here?
quiz.py: lí zhè r duō yuǎn？

title: Because…so…: 因为…所以…
pattern: 因为 A，所以 B
explanation: 因为 (because) introduces the reason, 所以 (so) the result. Unlike English, Chinese often uses both words in the same sentence.

examples.en: Because it rained, I didn't go.
examples.py: yīn wèi xià yǔ， suǒ yǐ wǒ mò qù。

examples.zh: 因为他病了，所以不能来。
examples.en: He is ill, so he can't come.
examples.py: yīn wèi tā bìng le， suǒ yǐ bù néng lái。

examples.zh: 因为太贵了，所以我没买。
examples.en: It was too expensive, so I didn't buy it.
examples.py: yīn wèi tài guì le， suǒ yǐ wǒ mò mǎi。

quiz.en: Because I am busy, I can't go.
quiz.answer: 因为我很忙，所以不能去。
quiz.py: yīn wèi wǒ hěn máng， suǒ yǐ bù néng qù。

options: 因为累了，所以我想休息。
所以累了，因为我想休息。
累了因为，所以我想休息。

title: Although…but…: 虽然…但是…
pattern: 虽然 A，但是 B
explanation: 虽然 (although) opens the first clause, 但是 (but) the second. Chinese uses both together; you can also use 可是 instead of 但是.

examples.en: Although it is expensive, it is good.
examples.py: suī rán hěn guì， dàn shì hěn hǎo。

examples.zh: 虽然他很累，但是还在工作。
examples.en: Although he is tired, he is still working.
examples.py: suī rán tā hěn lèi， dàn shì hái zài gōng zuò。

examples.en: Although it snowed, it is not cold.
examples.py: suī rán xià xuě le， kě shì bù lěng。

quiz.en: Although it is far, I want to go.
quiz.py: suī rán hěn yuǎn， dàn shì wǒ xiǎng qù。

quiz.prompt: 'Though he is young, he knows a lot.'
options: 虽然他很小，但是知道很多。
但是他很小，虽然知道很多。
他很小虽然，但是知道很多。

title: Giving directions with 往 and 从
pattern: 从 A 到 B ；往 + direction + verb
explanation: 从 means 'from' and 到 means 'to': 从家到学校 — from home to school. 往 (wǎng) means 'towards': 往前走 — go straight ahead, 往左拐 — turn left.

examples.py: wǎng qián zǒu， rán hòu wǎng yòu guǎi。
wǒ cóng shàng hǎi lái。

examples.zh: 从这儿到那儿要十分钟。
examples.en: From here to there takes ten minutes.
examples.py: cóng zhè r dào nà r yào shí fēn zhōng。

quiz.en: I walk from home to the station.
quiz.py: wǒ cóng jiā zǒu dào chē zhàn。

title: Already and not yet: 已经 and 还没
pattern: 已经 + verb + 了 ；还没 + verb
explanation: 已经…了 means 'already': 我已经吃了 — I have already eaten. 还没 means 'not yet' and never takes 了: 我还没吃 — I haven't eaten yet.

examples.py: wǒ yǐ jīng dào le。

examples.en: He has not got up yet.
examples.py: tā hái mò qǐ chuáng。
nǐ yǐ jīng kàn guò le má？

quiz.py: tā men yǐ jīng zǒu le。

title: The 把 sentence
pattern: Subject + 把 + object + verb + result
explanation: 把 (bǎ) moves the object before the verb to focus on what happens to it. The verb must have something after it — 了, a result, or a place: 我把书放在桌子上 — I put the book on the table.

examples.py: qǐng bǎ mén guān shàng。
wǒ bǎ zuò yè zuò wán le。

examples.en: He put the money in the bag.
examples.py: tā bǎ qián fàng zài bāo lǐ le。

quiz.py: qǐng bǎ chuāng hu dǎ kāi。

title: Passive with 被
pattern: Object + 被 + (doer) + verb + result
explanation: 被 (bèi) makes a passive sentence, often for something unpleasant: 我的手机被偷了 — my phone was stolen. The doer after 被 can be left out.

examples.py: wǒ de zì xíng chē bèi tōu le。

examples.en: The cake was eaten by my little brother.
examples.py: dàn gāo bèi dì di chī le。

examples.en: He was criticised by the teacher.
examples.py: tā bèi lǎo shī pī píng le。

quiz.en: The window was broken by the wind.
quiz.py: chuāng hu bèi fēng chuī huài le。

options: the doer in a passive sentence
the object in a 把 sentence

title: Direction complements: 来 and 去
pattern: Verb + 上/下/进/出/回/过 + 来/去
explanation: 来 means towards the speaker, 去 away from the speaker. Combine them with 上, 下, 进, 出, 回, 过 after a verb: 走进来 — walk in (towards me), 跑出去 — run out (away from me).

examples.py: qǐng jìn lái。
tā cóng lóu shàng pǎo xià lai le。
bǎ shū ná huí qu ba。

quiz.prompt: You are inside. 'He walked in' is…

quiz.py: qǐng ná shàng lái。

title: Ever more: 越来越 and 越…越…
pattern: 越来越 + adjective ；越 A 越 B
explanation: 越来越 means 'more and more': 天气越来越热 — the weather is getting hotter. 越…越… means 'the more…, the more…': 越学越喜欢 — the more I study, the more I like it.

examples.en: The weather is getting colder and colder.
examples.py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le。

examples.en: His Chinese is getting better and better.
examples.py: tā de Hàn yǔ yuè lái yuè hǎo。

examples.en: The more I look, the more I like it.
examples.py: wǒ yuè kàn yuè xǐ huan。

quiz.en: More and more people learn Chinese.
quiz.py: yuè lái yuè duō de rén xué Hàn yǔ。

quiz.prompt: 'The more you eat, the fatter you get.'

title: Just happened: 刚 and 刚才
pattern: 刚 + verb ；刚才 + sentence
explanation: 刚 (gāng) is an adverb before the verb: 我刚到 — I just arrived. 刚才 (gāngcái) is a time word, 'a moment ago', and can start the sentence: 刚才他来过.

examples.py: wǒ gāng chī wán fàn。

examples.en: Where did you go just now?
examples.py: gāng cái nǐ qù nǎ r le？

examples.en: He just came back from Beijing.
examples.py: tā gāng cóng Běi jīng huí lai。

quiz.py: wǒ gāng dào jiā。

title: Duration after the verb
pattern: Verb + (object) + verb + duration ；verb + 了 + duration + (的) object
explanation: How long you did something comes after the verb: 我学了两年汉语 — I studied Chinese for two years. With an object, either repeat the verb (学汉语学了两年) or put the time between verb and object.

examples.en: I waited for half an hour.
examples.py: wǒ děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí。

examples.en: He has studied Chinese for three years.
examples.py: tā xué Hàn yǔ xué le sān nián。
wǒ men zǒu le shí fēn zhōng de lù。

quiz.py: wǒ shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí。

options: 他看电视两个小时了看。

title: Only if: 只要…就… / 只有…才…
pattern: 只要 A，就 B ；只有 A，才 B
explanation: 只要…就… means 'as long as A, then B' — A is enough. 只有…才… means 'only if A, then B' — A is required. 就 and 才 go after the subject of the second clause.

examples.en: As long as you work hard, you can learn it well.
examples.py: zhǐ yào nǔ lì， jiù néng xué hǎo。

examples.zh: 只有多练习，才能说得好。
examples.en: Only by practising a lot can you speak well.
examples.py: zhǐ yǒu duō liàn xí， cái néng shuō dé hǎo。

examples.en: As long as you come, I'll be happy.
examples.py: zhǐ yào nǐ lái， wǒ jiù gāo xìng。

quiz.en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go.
quiz.py: zhǐ yào bù xià yǔ， wǒ men jiù qù。

title: Reduplicating verbs: 看看, 试一试
pattern: Verb + verb ；verb + 一 + verb
explanation: Repeating a verb makes it light and casual, 'have a little…': 看看 — take a look, 试试 or 试一试 — give it a try. Two-syllable verbs repeat whole: 休息休息.

examples.en: Have a look at this book.
examples.py: nǐ kàn kàn zhè běn shū。

examples.en: I'd like to give it a try.
examples.py: wǒ xiǎng shì yī shì。
wǒ men xiū xi xiū xi ba。

quiz.py: wǒ men liáo liáo ba。

title: Emphasis with 是…的
pattern: 是 + time / place / way + verb + 的
explanation: Use 是…的 to stress when, where or how something already happened: 我是昨天来的 — it was yesterday that I came. 是 can be dropped in speech; 的 cannot.

examples.en: I came to China last year.
examples.py: wǒ shì qù nián lái Zhōng guó de。
nǐ shì zěn me lái de？
tā shì zài Běi jīng chū shēng de。

quiz.py: wǒ shì zuò fēi jī lái de。

title: Even…: 连…都/也…
pattern: 连 + X + 都/也 + verb
explanation: 连…都… means 'even': 他连水都不喝 — he doesn't even drink water. It highlights an extreme case; the stressed part goes between 连 and 都.

examples.py: tā lián zǎo fàn dōu mò chī。

examples.zh: 这个字连老师也不认识。
examples.en: Even the teacher doesn't know this character.
examples.py: zhè gè zì lián lǎo shī yě bù rèn shi。

examples.en: I don't have even one cent.
examples.py: wǒ lián yī fēn qián dōu méi yǒu。

quiz.en: He doesn't even know my name.
quiz.answer: 他连我的名字都不知道。
quiz.py: tā lián wǒ de míng zi dōu bù zhī dào。

title: Except for: 除了…以外
pattern: 除了 A（以外），都 / 还 B
explanation: With 都, 除了 means 'except': 除了他，大家都来了 — everyone came except him. With 还 or 也 it means 'besides, in addition': 除了汉语，我还学英语.

examples.py: chú le xiǎo wáng， dà jiā dōu lái le。

examples.zh: 除了汉语，我还会说英语。
examples.en: Besides Chinese, I can also speak English.
examples.py: chú le Hàn yǔ， wǒ hái huì shuō Yīng yǔ。

examples.zh: 除了周末以外，他每天都上班。
examples.en: He works every day except weekends.
examples.py: chú le zhōu mò yǐ wài， tā měi tiān dōu shàng bān。

quiz.en: Apart from apples, I also like bananas.
quiz.answer: 除了苹果，我也喜欢香蕉。
quiz.py: chú le píng guǒ， wǒ yě xǐ huan xiāng jiāo。

title: Result complements: 完, 好, 到, 见
pattern: Verb + 完 / 好 / 到 / 见
explanation: A result word after the verb tells how it ended: 吃完 — finish eating, 做好 — do well / get done, 找到 — find (succeed in looking), 看见 — see (succeed in looking). Negate with 没.

examples.py: wǒ zuò wán zuò yè le。
nǐ zhǎo dào yào shi le má？
wǒ mò kàn jiàn tā。

quiz.py: wǒ tīng dào shēng yīn le。

title: Not only…but also: 不但…而且…
pattern: 不但 A，而且 B
explanation: 不但…而且… adds a second, stronger point. If both clauses share a subject, it goes before 不但; otherwise each clause has its own subject after the connector.

examples.zh: 他不但会说汉语，而且说得很好。
examples.en: He not only speaks Chinese, but speaks it well.
examples.py: tā bù dàn huì shuō Hàn yǔ， ér qiě shuō dé hěn hǎo。

examples.zh: 这里不但风景美，而且空气好。
examples.en: Not only is the scenery beautiful here, the air is good too.
examples.py: zhè lǐ bù dàn fēng jǐng měi， ér qiě kōng qì hǎo。

examples.zh: 不但我喜欢，而且孩子们也喜欢。
examples.en: Not only do I like it, the children like it too.
examples.py: bù dàn wǒ xǐ huan， ér qiě hái zi men yě xǐ huan。

quiz.en: She is not only clever but also hard-working.
quiz.py: tā bù dàn cōng ming， ér qiě nǔ lì。

quiz.prompt: Where does a shared subject go?

title: Whether or not: 无论…都…
pattern: 无论 / 不管 + question + 都 + result
explanation: 无论 or 不管 introduces a condition that does not matter — a question word or 'A or B' — and 都 states the unchanged result: 无论多忙，他都锻炼 — no matter how busy he is, he exercises.

examples.zh: 无论天气怎么样，我们都去。
examples.py: wú lùn tiān qì zěn me yàng， wǒ men dōu qù。

examples.en: Whether you go or not, I'm going.
examples.py: bù guǎn nǐ qù bù qù， wǒ dōu qù。

examples.en: No matter how hard it is, he never gives up.
examples.py: wú lùn duō nán， tā dōu bù fàng qì。

quiz.en: No matter who asks, I won't say.
quiz.py: wú lùn shéi wèn， wǒ dōu bù shuō。

title: Even if: 即使…也… / 就是…也…
pattern: 即使 A，也 B
explanation: 即使…也… means 'even if': the condition is imagined or extreme, and the result still holds. 哪怕 and 就是 are spoken alternatives for 即使.

examples.en: Even if it rains, I'll go.
examples.py: jí shǐ xià yǔ， wǒ yě yào qù。

examples.zh: 即使他不来，我们也开始。
examples.en: Even if he doesn't come, we'll start.
examples.py: jí shǐ tā bù lái， wǒ men yě kāi shǐ。

examples.zh: 哪怕只有一分钟，也要练习。
examples.en: Even if it's only one minute, practise.
examples.py: nǎ pà zhǐ yǒu yī fēn zhōng， yě yào liàn xí。

quiz.en: Even if it's expensive, I'll buy it.
quiz.py: jí shǐ hěn guì， wǒ yě mǎi。

title: Adverbs of degree: 稍微, 相当, 十分, 极了
pattern: 稍微 + adj + 一点儿 ；adj + 极了
explanation: Degree words shade an adjective. 稍微…一点儿 — slightly; 相当 — fairly; 十分 / 非常 — very; 极了 after the adjective — extremely. Pick one; do not stack them.

examples.py: jīn tiān shāo wēi lěng yī diǎn r。
zhè dào tí xiāng dāng nán。

examples.en: The scenery here is extremely beautiful.
examples.py: zhè lǐ de fēng jǐng měi jí le。

quiz.py: zhè dào cài hǎo chī jí le。

title: Complements of state and potential: 起来, 下去
pattern: Verb + 起来 (start / seem) ；verb + 下去 (continue)
explanation: 起来 after a verb can mean the action starts (笑起来 — start laughing) or how something seems when you do it (看起来很好 — looks good). 下去 means to keep going: 说下去 — go on speaking.

examples.zh: 听了这话，大家都笑起来了。
examples.py: tīng le zhè huà， dà jiā dōu xiào qi lai le。
zhè gè cài kàn qǐ lai hěn hǎo chī。
qǐng nǐ shuō xià qù。

quiz.py: wǒ men bì xū xué xià qù。

quiz.prompt: 下去 after a verb means…

title: Successive actions: 先…然后…再…
pattern: 先 A，然后 B，再 C ；一…就…
explanation: 先, 然后, 再 and 最后 line up actions in order. 一…就… means 'as soon as A, B': 我一到家就给你打电话 — I'll call you as soon as I get home.

examples.en: Wash your hands first, then eat.
examples.py: xiān xǐ shǒu， rán hòu chī fàn。

examples.zh: 我们先去商店，再去公园。
examples.en: We'll go to the shop first, then the park.
examples.py: wǒ men xiān qù shāng diàn， zài qù gōng yuán。

examples.en: He goes home as soon as class ends.
examples.py: tā yī xià kè jiù huí jiā。

quiz.en: As soon as I saw her, I recognised her.
quiz.answer: 我一看见她就认出来了。
quiz.py: wǒ yī kàn jiàn tā jiù rèn chū lái le。

title: Rhetorical questions: 难道, 不是…吗
pattern: 难道 + statement + 吗？ ；不是…吗？
explanation: 难道…吗 asks a question whose answer is obvious: 难道你不知道吗？ — don't you know?! 不是…吗 does the same: 你不是说要来吗？ — didn't you say you'd come?

examples.py: nán dào nǐ wàng le má？
nǐ bù shì yǐ jīng chī guò le má？
nán dào zhè bù shì nǐ de cuò？

quiz.en: Didn't you say you were busy?
quiz.py: nǐ bù shì shuō nǐ hěn máng má？

title: Making people do things: 让, 叫, 请, 使
pattern: Subject + 让 / 叫 / 请 / 使 + person + verb
explanation: These pivot verbs put a person between two verbs. 让 and 叫 — make or let someone do; 请 — politely invite; 使 — cause (formal, usually with feelings): 这个消息使我很高兴.

examples.en: Mum told me to come home early.
examples.py: mā ma ràng wǒ zǎo diǎn ér huí jiā。

examples.en: The teacher asked him to answer.
examples.py: lǎo shī jiào tā huí dá wèn tí。

examples.en: This matter made me very sad.
examples.py: zhè jiàn shì shǐ wǒ hěn nán guò。

quiz.en: The boss let us leave early.
quiz.py: lǎo bǎn ràng wǒ men zǎo diǎn ér zǒu。

title: Approximate numbers: 左右, 大约, 多, 几
pattern: Number + 左右 ；大约 + number ；number + 多
explanation: 左右 after a number means 'about'; 大约 before it means the same. 多 after a round number adds 'more than': 三十多 — thirty-odd. 几 stands for an unknown small number: 几个 — a few.

examples.py: wǒ men dà yuē bā diǎn dào。
tā sān shí suì zuǒ yòu。

examples.en: There are over a hundred people here.
examples.py: zhè lǐ yǒu yī bǎi duō gè rén。

quiz.py: dà yuē yào shí fēn zhōng。

title: Opinion and concession: 其实, 反正, 到底
pattern: 其实 / 反正 + statement ；到底 + question
explanation: 其实 — actually, in fact, corrects an assumption. 反正 — anyway, in any case, says the outcome won't change. 到底 in a question presses for the real answer: 你到底去不去？

examples.py: qí shí wǒ bù xǐ huan kā fēi。

examples.en: In any case, I'm not going.
examples.py: fǎn zhèng wǒ bù qù。

examples.en: What on earth do you want?
examples.py: nǐ dào dǐ xiǎng yào shén me？

quiz.py: fǎn zhèng tā bù huì tóng yì。

title: Formal prepositions: 对于, 关于, 至于
pattern: 对于 / 关于 + topic，statement ；至于 + topic
explanation: 对于 — regarding, as for (attitude towards something); 关于 — about (the subject matter), often at the very start; 至于 — as for, switching to a related topic, often with a reservation.

examples.zh: 对于这个问题，我没有意见。
examples.en: Regarding this question, I have no objection.
examples.py: duì yú zhè gè wèn tí， wǒ méi yǒu yì jiàn。

examples.zh: 关于中国历史，他知道很多。
examples.en: He knows a lot about Chinese history.
examples.py: guān yú Zhōng guó lì shǐ， tā zhī dào hěn duō。

examples.zh: 至于价格，我们以后再谈。
examples.en: As for the price, we'll discuss it later.
examples.py: zhì yú jià gé， wǒ men yǐ hòu zài tán。

quiz.en: As for him, I don't know.
quiz.py: zhì yú tā， wǒ bù zhī dào。

title: Conditions: 既然…就…, 否则, 要不然
pattern: 既然 A，就 B ；A，否则 B
explanation: 既然…就… means 'since A (is already true), then B'. 否则 and 要不然 mean 'otherwise': state what happens if the first clause is not met.

examples.zh: 既然你不舒服，就休息吧。
examples.py: jì rán nǐ bù shū fu， jiù xiū xi ba。
kuài diǎn r， fǒu zé yào chí dào le。

examples.en: Take an umbrella, or you'll get wet.
examples.py: dài shàng sǎn， yào bù rán huì lìn shī。

quiz.answer: 既然你知道，为什么还问？
quiz.py: jì rán nǐ zhī dào， wèi shén me hái wèn？

title: Emphatic negatives: 并不, 并没有, 从来不
pattern: 并 + 不 / 没有 ；从来 + 不 / 没
explanation: 并 before 不 or 没 corrects what someone assumed: 我并不喜欢 — I actually don't like it. 从来不 — never (habit); 从来没 + verb + 过 — never once (experience).

examples.py: wǒ bìng bù rèn shi tā。
tā cóng lái bù chí dào。

examples.en: I have never been to America.
examples.py: wǒ cóng lái mò qù guò měi guó。

quiz.py: wǒ bìng méi yǒu nà me shuō。

title: Word order with 把 and complex complements
pattern: 把 + object + verb + 成 / 给 / 到 / 在 + phrase
explanation: At this level 把 sentences carry richer results: 把 A 翻译成 B — translate A into B; 把 A 交给 B — hand A to B; 把 A 放到 B — put A onto B. The result phrase always follows the verb.

examples.zh: 请把这句话翻译成英文。
examples.en: Please translate this sentence into English.
examples.py: qǐng bǎ zhè jù huà fān yì chéng Yīng wén。

examples.en: He handed the report to the manager.
examples.py: tā bǎ bào gào jiāo gěi le jīng lǐ。
wǒ bǎ zhào piàn fā dào le wǎng shàng。

quiz.en: She changed the plan into a new one.
quiz.py: tā bǎ jì huà gǎi chéng le xīn de。

title: Four-character idioms in sentences
pattern: Subject + 成语 (as predicate or adverb)
explanation: 成语 are four-character set phrases. Many work as adjectives or adverbs: 他做事一丝不苟 — he does things meticulously. Learn each as a unit, and note whether it takes an object.

examples.zh: 他的话让大家莫名其妙。
examples.py: tā de huà ràng dà jiā mò míng qí miào。

examples.zh: 这个孩子全神贯注地听课。
examples.en: The child listened with total concentration.
examples.py: zhè gè hái zi quán shén guàn zhù dì tīng kè。

examples.en: We should seek truth from facts.
examples.py: wǒ men yīng gāi shí shì qiú shì。

quiz.py: tā quán shén guàn zhù dì huí dá。

quiz.prompt: A 成语 used as an adverb takes…

title: Structural particles: 地, 得, 的 together
pattern: adj + 地 + verb ；verb + 得 + adj ；adj + 的 + noun
explanation: All three are pronounced de. 的 links to a noun (红的花), 地 turns an adjective into an adverb before a verb (慢慢地走), 得 follows the verb to describe its result (走得很慢).

examples.py: tā rèn zhēn dì kàn zháo wǒ。
tā shuō dé fēi cháng qīng chu。
zhè shì yī gè měi lì de chéng shì。

quiz.prompt: Which de goes before a verb?

quiz.py: tā gāo xìng dì pǎo le chū qù。

title: Counting events: 次, 遍, 趟, 下
pattern: Verb + number + 次 / 遍 / 趟 / 下
explanation: Verbal measure words count how many times. 次 — times; 遍 — times from start to finish (读一遍); 趟 — trips (去一趟); 下 — brief actions (敲一下). They follow the verb and precede a noun object.

examples.en: I read this book three times through.
examples.py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn le sān biàn。

examples.en: I made a trip to the bank.
examples.py: wǒ qù le yī tāng yín háng。
qǐng nǐ děng yī xià。

quiz.prompt: 'Read it once more from start to finish' uses…

quiz.en: I have been to Beijing twice.
quiz.py: wǒ qù guò liǎng cì Běi jīng。

title: Expressing change and tendency: 逐渐, 日益, 不断
pattern: 逐渐 / 日益 / 不断 + verb or adjective
explanation: 逐渐 — gradually; 日益 — increasingly, day by day (formal); 不断 — continuously, without stopping. They sit before the verb or adjective and are common in written and news Chinese.

examples.en: The weather is gradually getting warmer.
examples.py: tiān qì zhú jiàn biàn nuǎn。

examples.en: The city grows more prosperous by the day.
examples.py: zhè zuò chéng shì rì yì fán róng。
wǒ men yào bù duàn xué xí。

quiz.py: jià gé bù duàn shàng zhǎng。

quiz.prompt: 日益 is mostly used in…

title: Classical remnants: 之, 其, 以, 而
pattern: A 之 B ；以 + means ；A 而 B
explanation: Modern formal Chinese keeps classical particles. 之 — possessive like 的 in set phrases (成功之路); 其 — its / their; 以 — by means of, in order to; 而 — and yet / and then, linking clauses.

examples.en: This is the road to success.
examples.py: zhè shì chéng gōng zhī lù。

examples.en: We should take facts as our basis.
examples.py: wǒ men yīng yǐ shì shí wéi yī jù。
tā suī nián qīng ér jīng yàn fēng fù。

quiz.prompt: 之 in 成功之路 works like…

quiz.en: Solve the problem by means of dialogue.
quiz.py: yǐ duì huà jiě jué wèn tí。

options: two clauses with contrast or sequence

title: Formal written connectors: 鉴于, 倘若, 以致, 从而
pattern: 鉴于 A，B ；倘若 A，B ；A，以致 / 从而 B
explanation: 鉴于 — in view of; 倘若 — if (literary); 以致 — so that (usually a bad result); 从而 — thereby (a logical consequence, often good). These mark essays, reports and news.

examples.zh: 鉴于目前的情况，会议推迟。
examples.en: In view of the current situation, the meeting is postponed.
examples.py: jiàn yú mù qián de qíng kuàng， huì yì tuī chí。

examples.zh: 倘若明天下雨，活动取消。
examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, the event is cancelled.
examples.py: tǎng ruò míng tiān xià yǔ， huó dòng qǔ xiāo。

examples.zh: 他努力工作，从而获得了晋升。
examples.en: He worked hard and thereby won promotion.
examples.py: tā nǔ lì gōng zuò， cóng ér huò dé le jìn shēng。

quiz.prompt: A bad result is introduced by…

quiz.en: If you agree, we start immediately.
quiz.answer: 倘若你同意，我们立刻开始。
quiz.py: tǎng ruò nǐ tóng yì， wǒ men lì kè kāi shǐ。

title: Double negatives for emphasis: 不得不, 非…不可, 无不
pattern: 不得不 + verb ；非 + verb + 不可 ；无不 + verb
explanation: 不得不 — have no choice but to; 非…不可 — absolutely must; 无不 — without exception, all. Two negatives make a strong positive.

examples.zh: 因为生病，他不得不请假。
examples.en: Being ill, he had no choice but to take leave.
examples.py: yīn wèi shēng bìng， tā bù dé bù qǐng jià。
zhè jiàn shì wǒ fēi zuò bù kě。

examples.zh: 听了他的话，大家无不感动。
examples.en: Hearing his words, everyone was moved.
examples.py: tīng le tā de huà， dà jiā wú bù gǎn dòng。

quiz.py: wǒ jīn tiān fēi jiàn tā bù kě。

title: Degree and extent: 之极, 不堪, 不已, 万分
pattern: adj + 之极 / 不堪 / 不已 ；万分 + adj
explanation: Literary intensifiers: 之极 — to the extreme; 不堪 — unbearably (bad things); 不已 — endlessly (feelings); 万分 — extremely (before an adjective). They replace 非常 in formal writing.

examples.en: He felt extremely regretful about it.
examples.py: tā duì cǐ gǎn dào yí hàn zhī jí。

examples.en: The conditions here are unbearably chaotic.
examples.py: zhè lǐ de huán jìng hùn luàn bù kān。

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，她激动不已。
examples.en: Hearing the news, she was overwhelmed with excitement.
examples.py: tīng dào zhè gè xiāo xi， tā jī dòng bù yǐ。

quiz.py: wǒ men wàn fēn gǎn xiè。

title: Nominalising with 所 and 者
pattern: 所 + verb + 的 ；verb + 者
explanation: 所 before a verb turns it into 'that which is …ed': 所说的 — what was said. 者 after a verb or adjective means 'the one who': 读者 — reader, 强者 — the strong. Common in formal and written styles.

examples.py: tā suǒ shuō de dōu shì shì shí。
dú zhě kě yǐ zài xiàn liú yán。

examples.en: What I know about the situation is limited.
examples.py: wǒ suǒ liǎo jiě de qíng kuàng bù duō。

quiz.py: huò shèng zhě jiāng dé dào jiǎng pǐn。

title: Complex comparisons: 不如, 与其…不如…, 莫过于
pattern: A 不如 B ；与其 A，不如 B ；最 + adj + 的莫过于 + X
explanation: 不如 — not as good as; 与其…不如… — rather than A, better B; 莫过于 — nothing surpasses: 最让人高兴的莫过于团聚 — nothing is happier than a reunion.

examples.en: Taking the bus isn't as quick as walking.
examples.py: zuò chē bù rú zǒu lù kuài。
yǔ qí bào yuàn， bù rú xíng dòng。

examples.zh: 最大的幸福莫过于健康。
examples.en: No happiness is greater than health.
examples.py: zuì dà de xìng fú mò guò yú jiàn kāng。

quiz.en: Talking isn't as good as doing.
quiz.py: shuō bù rú zuò。

title: Formal passives and causatives: 为…所, 遭到, 予以
pattern: A 为 B 所 + verb ；遭到 / 受到 + noun ；予以 + verb
explanation: 为…所 is a written passive: 为人所知 — known to people. 遭到 (suffer, negative) and 受到 (receive) take a noun: 遭到批评. 予以 + two-syllable verb means 'to give / carry out' in official language: 予以处理.

examples.zh: 这个观点已为大家所接受。
examples.en: This view has been accepted by everyone.
examples.py: zhè gè guān diǎn yǐ wéi dà jiā suǒ jiē shòu。
tā de jì huà zāo dào le fǎn duì。

examples.en: The relevant department will carry out an investigation.
examples.py: yǒu guān bù mén jiāng yǔ yǐ diào chá。

quiz.en: This book is loved by readers.
quiz.py: zhè běn shū wéi dú zhě suǒ xǐ ài。

title: Discourse markers in speeches and essays: 总而言之, 换言之, 由此可见
pattern: Marker + ，conclusion
explanation: Essay connectors organise an argument. 总而言之 — in short; 换言之 — in other words; 由此可见 — from this we can see; 综上所述 — to sum up the above. Place them at the start of the concluding sentence.

examples.zh: 总而言之，这次活动很成功。
examples.en: In short, the event was a success.
examples.py: zǒng ér yán zhī， zhè cì huó dòng hěn chéng gōng。

examples.zh: 由此可见，锻炼对健康很重要。
examples.en: From this we can see exercise is important for health.
examples.py: yóu cǐ kě jiàn， duàn liàn duì jiàn kāng hěn zhòng yào。

examples.zh: 综上所述，我们应该采取行动。
examples.en: To sum up, we should take action.
examples.py: zōng shàng suǒ shù， wǒ men yīng gāi cǎi qǔ xíng dòng。

quiz.py: zǒng ér yán zhī， wǒ tóng yì。
